description: Follow-up from PR #876 review: jido_chat should define shared delivery error categories, failure stage and delivery certainty; Mattermost/Discord/Telegram adapters translate SDK/provider errors. Current successes normalize to Response while errors mix atoms, HTTP tuples and SDK structures. Preserve diagnostics separately from safe user-facing explanations. Replace ZAQ temporary error-shape matching after adopting upstream contract. Do not infer provider limits from Jido common multiple-attachment rejection. Requires work in upstream libraries; not prerequisite to current minimal user-facing fallback.
title: [jido_chat] Standardize adapter delivery failure contract
